proof:
Source: Simon, Ch. 8, 5.1–5.4 and the surrounding printed argument (p. 215), the extraction via “the Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1”, the stationarity “by definition of δV (in 2)”, 5.2 and 3.4 for radial rigidity, and “the same argument as in the proof of Theorem 6.1 of Ch. 4, except that we use 3.5” for homogeneity; and, for the second conjunct, the blow-up use of the semicontinuity theorem 3.7 made in the proofs of 5.5 (steps (3)–(7)) and 5.7. ERRATA: (5.2) printed μ_C(B_ρ(x)) must read μ_C(B_ρ(0)); (5.3) printed λ^{-n}μ_C(η_{0,λ}(A)) = μ_C(A) has the wrong power — the correct homogeneity is μ_C(sA) = s^n μ_C(A) (SimonGMT TangentScalingCounterexample); (3.5) the sign in front of δV(X) is “−” (SimonGMT WeightedRadialIdentity.lean header) — irrelevant here since δC = 0; the cited “Theorem 6.1 of Ch. 4” is not present in this edition, so the homogeneity argument is written out in step A5 (it is 3.5 with V = C, x = 0, ρ so large that φ(r/ρ) ≡ 1 on spt h). In the proof of 5.5, printed (5) “Θ^n(μ_{V_j}, y) ≤ θ0 − ε_j” must read “≥”. Notation: G = Grassmannian N n; μ_W = W.weight; ‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V; B_ρ(y) closed ball, B°_ρ(y) open ball; V_{x,t} := rescaledMeasure V x t = t^{-n}·η_{x,t#}V with η_{x,t}(z,S) = ((z−x)/t, S); ω_n = unitBallVolume n; “→” between measures on ℝ^N × G means VagueConverges (convergence of ∫ f for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G)).

PRELIMINARY FACTS (used repeatedly).
R1 (rescaled masses). For t, R > 0: V_{x,t}(B_R(0) × G) = t^{-n} μ_V(B_{tR}(x)) = ω_n R^n · densityRatio n μ_V x (tR). (Measure.map_apply; the preimage of B_R(0) × G is B_{tR}(x) × G; SimonGMT blowUpWeight_closedBall, TangentRescaling.lean:119, rescaledMeasure V x t being V.blowUpMeasure x t by unfolding.)
R2 (first variation scaling). For X ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N;ℝ^N) with tsupport X ⊆ B°_R(0) and t > 0 with B_{tR}(x) ⊆ U, put Y(z) := t X((z−x)/t); then DY(z) = DX((z−x)/t), Y ∈ K(U;ℝ^N), tsupport Y ⊆ B°_{tR}(x) and ∫ div_S X dV_{x,t} = t^{-n} ∫ div_S X((z−x)/t) dV(z,S) = t^{-n} δV(Y). By 2.6 (sibling first_variation: δV(Y) = −∫ν·Y d‖δV‖, |ν| = 1), |δV(Y)| ≤ sup|Y| ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)) = t sup|X| ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)). Hence |∫ div_S X dV_{x,t}| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (tR)^{1−n} ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)).
R3 (portmanteau for weights). If W_j → W vaguely on ℝ^N × G then μ_{W_j} → μ_W against C_c(ℝ^N) (lift g to (y,S) ↦ g(y), compactly supported because G is compact), hence μ_W(O) ≤ liminf μ_{W_j}(O) for open O and μ_W(K) ≥ limsup μ_{W_j}(K) for compact K; more generally ∫ F dW_j → ∫ F dW for bounded Borel F with compact support whose discontinuity set is W-null.

PART A: VarifoldTangentCones. Hypotheses: V has LBFV, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, HasDensity n μ_V x θ0, and (5.1) ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) = ofReal ρ · ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/ofReal ρ^n → 0 as ρ ↓ 0.
A1 (extraction; printed “by the Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1”). Let t_j > 0, t_j → 0. For compact K ⊆ ℝ^N choose R with K ⊆ B_R(0); by R1 and HasDensity, V_{x,t_j}(K × G) ≤ ω_n R^n densityRatio(t_jR) → θ0 ω_n R^n, so V_{x,t_j}(K × G) ≤ θ0ω_nR^n + 1 for j large. The sibling radon_compactness (with U := ℝ^N = univ, μ_j := V_{x,t_j}) gives a strictly increasing φ and C : Varifold N n univ with ∫ f dV_{x,t_{φ(j)}} → ∫ f dC for all f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) (the support condition tsupport f ⊆ univ × G is automatic), i.e. VagueConverges. This is conclusion (a).
Now let C be any varifold tangent: t_j > 0, t_j → 0 (not necessarily monotone) and V_j := V_{x,t_j} → C.
A2 (C is stationary; printed “by definition of δV”). For X ∈ K(ℝ^N;ℝ^N), div_S X(y) is continuous with compact support in ℝ^N × G (SimonGMT continuous_tangentialDivergence, hasCompactSupport_tangentialDivergence), so δC(X) = lim_j ∫ div_S X dV_j. Choose R with tsupport X ⊆ B°_R(0); for j large B_{t_jR}(x) ⊆ U and by R2, |∫ div_S X dV_j| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)) → 0 by (5.1). Hence δC(X) = 0, C.Stationary.
A3 (5.2, corrected centre 0). Fix ρ > 0. By R1, μ_{V_j}(B_ρ(0)) = ω_nρ^n densityRatio(t_jρ) → θ0 ω_n ρ^n (also for every ρ' > 0). By R3: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) ≥ limsup μ_{V_j}(B_ρ(0)) = θ0ω_nρ^n; and for every ρ' > ρ, μ_C(B_ρ(0)) ≤ μ_C(B°_{ρ'}(0)) ≤ liminf μ_{V_j}(B°_{ρ'}(0)) ≤ lim μ_{V_j}(B_{ρ'}(0)) = θ0ω_nρ'^n; letting ρ' ↓ ρ gives equality: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n for all ρ > 0 (in ℝ≥0∞: ofReal θ0 · unitBallVolume n · ofReal ρ ^ n).
A4 (radial rigidity; printed “Since δC = 0 we can use 5.2 together with 3.4”). C is stationary on ℝ^N, so the sibling monotonicity_density (second conjunct StationaryMonotonicityIdentity, with U = ℝ^N, centre 0, any ρ0) gives Θ^n(μ_C,0) + ω_n^{-1} normalDefect C 0 (B_ρ(0)) = densityRatio n μ_C 0 ρ = θ0 for all ρ > 0, and Θ^n(μ_C, 0) = lim densityRatio = θ0 (finite). So ∫_{Gₙ(B_ρ(0))} |p_{S⊥}(y)|²/|y|^{n+2} dC = 0 for all ρ, hence p_{S⊥}(y) = 0 for C-a.e. (y,S), and since (y,S) ↦ p_{S⊥}(y) is continuous, p_{S⊥}(y) = 0, i.e. y ∈ S, for every (y,S) ∈ spt C. (Formal: SimonGMT Stationary.radial_mem_plane_of_mem_support_of_constant_mass_ratio, TangentRadialRigidity.lean:122, whose mass hypothesis is A3 in the normalisation μ_C(B_R(0))/ofReal(R^n) = θ0ω_n.)
A5 (homogeneity, corrected 5.3). Let g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N) and X(y) := g(y) y ∈ K(ℝ^N;ℝ^N). For S ∈ G: div_S X(y) = g(y) trace(p_S) + ⟨p_S(y), ∇g(y)⟩ = n g(y) + ⟨p_S(y), ∇g(y)⟩ (SimonGMT tangentialDivergence_smul, RadialFirstVariation.lean:257). On spt C, p_S(y) = y by A4, and C is carried by spt C, so stationarity gives
 (H) ∫ (n g(y) + ⟨y, ∇g(y)⟩) dμ_C(y) = 0 for every g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N).
 (This is 3.5 for V = C at x = 0 with h = g and φ(r/ρ) ≡ 1 on spt g: the defect term vanishes by A4, δC = 0, and ∇^S g·y = ∇g·p_S(y) = ∇g·y.) For s > 0 put F(s) := ∫ g(y/s) dμ_C(y). Differentiating under the integral (g ∈ C¹_c; for s in a compact subinterval of (0,∞) the integrands are supported in a fixed compact set and uniformly bounded; μ_C is finite on compacts), F'(s) = −s^{-1} ∫ ⟨y/s, ∇g(y/s)⟩ dμ_C(y). Applying (H) to g_s := g(·/s) (∇g_s(y) = s^{-1}∇g(y/s)) gives ∫ ⟨y/s, ∇g(y/s)⟩ dμ_C = −n F(s), so F'(s) = n F(s)/s and d/ds(s^{-n}F(s)) = 0. Hence ∫ g(y/s) dμ_C(y) = s^n ∫ g dμ_C for all s > 0 and g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N), and by uniform approximation (C¹_c is dense in C_c in sup norm with supports in a fixed compact set; μ_C is finite on compacts) for all g ∈ C_c(ℝ^N). Both (y ↦ y/s)_#μ_C and s^n μ_C are locally finite, hence regular, Borel measures on ℝ^N with the same integrals on C_c, so they are equal (Riesz uniqueness; Mathlib Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported). Since y ↦ y/s is a measurable equivalence (homeomorphism), Measure.map_apply holds for every set: μ_C(s • A) = ((y ↦ y/s)_#μ_C)(A) = s^n μ_C(A) for all A ⊆ ℝ^N (outer measure), i.e. C.weight (s • A) = ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A.
 A2–A5 give conclusion (b). This proves VarifoldTangentCones.

PART B: blow-up density lower bound (the use of 3.7 in the proofs of 5.5 (3)–(7) and 5.7). Hypotheses: V has LBFV, x ∈ U, τ > 0, (5.1) as above, and
 (E) ρ^{-n} μ_V(E ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, where E := {y : ¬ ∃ θ, HasDensity n μ_V y θ ∧ ofReal τ ≤ θ} (outer measure; E need not be measurable).
Claim: for every C : Varifold N n univ with IsVarifoldTangent V x C, for μ_C-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists and is ≥ τ.
B1 (restricted rescalings). Let t_j > 0, t_j → 0, V_{x,t_j} → C. Fix R ∈ ℕ_{≥1} and j0 with B_{t_j R}(x) ⊆ U for j ≥ j0. For j ≥ j0 let W_j be the n-varifold on Ω := B°_R(0) with measure V_{x,t_j} ⌞ (Ω × G) (vanishes off Ω × G; finite on K × G for compact K ⊆ Ω by R1), and C_Ω the varifold on Ω with measure C ⌞ (Ω × G). Also let W'_j, C'_Ω be the same varifolds with measures multiplied by τ^{-1} (a positive multiple of a varifold is a varifold; LBFV, variationMeasure and density scale by τ^{-1}; HasDensity n (τ^{-1}μ) y θ ⇔ HasDensity n μ y (τθ)).
B2 (convergence on Ω). Every f ∈ C_c(Ω × G) (subtype) extends by zero to f̃ ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) with tsupport ⊆ Ω × G, and ∫ f d(W_j)_dom = ∫ f̃ dV_{x,t_j} → ∫ f̃ dC = ∫ f d(C_Ω)_dom. So (W'_{j0+i})_i RadonConverges to C'_Ω.
B3 (first variation of W_j). For X ∈ K(Ω;ℝ^N), δW_j(X) = ∫ div_S X dV_{x,t_j} (div_S X vanishes off Ω × G), so by R2 with tsupport X ⊆ Ω: |δW_j(X)| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)). Hence firstVariationNormOn W_j O ≤ R^{n−1}(t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)) < ∞ for every O, so W_j has LBFV, and for open O ⊂⊂ Ω (sibling first_variation, 2.5) ‖δW_j‖(O) = firstVariationNormOn W_j O → 0 as j → ∞ by (5.1). In particular liminf_j ‖δW'_j‖(O) = 0 < ∞.
B4 (densities). For y ∈ Ω and ρ small (B_ρ(y) ⊆ Ω): μ_{W_j}(B_ρ(y)) = t_j^{-n} μ_V(B_{t_jρ}(x + t_j y)) (R1 recentred), so densityRatio n μ_{W_j} y ρ = densityRatio n μ_V (x + t_j y) (t_jρ); hence HasDensity n μ_{W_j} y θ ⇔ HasDensity n μ_V (x + t_jy) θ. Put B_j := {y ∈ Ω : x + t_j y ∈ E}. For y ∈ Ω ∖ B_j, Θ^n(μ_{W'_j}, y) exists and is ≥ 1. For W' ⊂⊂ Ω: μ_{W'_j}(B_j ∩ W') ≤ τ^{-1} t_j^{-n} μ_V(E ∩ B_{t_jR}(x)) = τ^{-1}R^n (t_jR)^{-n}μ_V(E ∩ B_{t_jR}(x)) → 0 by (E).
B5 (apply 3.7). The sibling density_semicontinuity (DensitySemicontinuity) applied on Ω to (W'_{j0+i})_i → C'_Ω with the sets B_{j0+i} yields: for μ_{C'_Ω}-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_{C'_Ω}, y) exists and is ≥ 1, i.e. for μ_C-a.e. y ∈ Ω = B°_R(0), Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists and is ≥ τ (for y ∈ Ω, small balls about y lie in Ω, so densities of C_Ω and C at y coincide; ofReal scaling by τ).
B6. Taking the union over R ∈ ℕ of the exceptional μ_C-null sets gives the claim on all of ℝ^N. This proves the second conjunct.
key_steps: Rescaled masses: V_{x,t}(B_R(0)×G) = ω_nR^n densityRatio(tR) → θ0ω_nR^n; radon_compactness with U = ℝ^N gives the extraction (a).
First-variation scaling ∫div_S X dV_{x,t} = t^{-n}δV(t X((·−x)/t)), bounded by sup|X|R^{n−1}(tR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)) → 0: C is stationary.
Portmanteau on closed/open balls: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0ω_nρ^n for every ρ (corrected centre 0).
3.4 at 0 with constant ratio: zero normal defect, so y ∈ S on spt C (SimonGMT radial rigidity).
Stationarity with X = g(y)y gives ∫(ng + y·∇g)dμ_C = 0; d/ds(s^{-n}∫g(y/s)dμ_C) = 0; Riesz uniqueness and the homeomorphism y ↦ y/s give μ_C(sA) = s^nμ_C(A) for all A (corrected 5.3).

(B) Restrict the rescalings to B°_R(0), scale by τ^{-1}: they are varifolds with ‖δ‖ → 0, densities transported from V, exceptional sets of vanishing mass; Theorem 3.7 (density_semicontinuity) on B°_R(0); union over R.
